G'oya

Rejani kunma-kun yuramiz. Har qadamda ikkita holatni olib boramiz: shu kunning rejasi (planned, har kuni step ga oshadi) va shu kungacha ekilgani (before). Rekursiya kechagacha ekilgan va bugungi reja yig'indisi need ga yetguncha davom etadi. Oxirgi kunda reja ortiqcha bo'lishi mumkin, uni yakuniy SELECT da qolgan miqdorgacha kesamiz.

Yechim

WITH RECURSIVE g(id, day, planned, before) AS (
  SELECT id, 1, first_day, 0
  FROM plans
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.id, g.day + 1, g.planned + p.step, g.before + g.planned
  FROM g
  JOIN plans p ON p.id = g.id
  WHERE g.before + g.planned < p.need
)
SELECT g.id, g.day,
       CASE WHEN g.before + g.planned > p.need THEN p.need - g.before ELSE g.planned END AS planted,
       CASE WHEN g.before + g.planned > p.need THEN p.need ELSE g.before + g.planned END AS total
FROM g
JOIN plans p ON p.id = g.id

Navro'z ko'chasida before 0, 10, 25, 45 bo'ladi. 4-kuni reja 25 tup, lekin 5 tup qolgan: CASE uni 5 ga kesadi. Shu kundan keyin 45 + 25 < 50 yolg'on, rekursiya to'xtaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Oxirgi kunni kesmaslik. Unda Navro'z ko'chasiga 4-kuni 25 tup ekiladi va jami 70 bo'lib ketadi:

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE g(id, day, planned, before) AS (
  SELECT id, 1, first_day, 0 FROM plans
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.id, g.day + 1, g.planned + p.step, g.before + g.planned
  FROM g JOIN plans p ON p.id = g.id
  WHERE g.before + g.planned < p.need
)
SELECT g.id, g.day, g.planned AS planted, g.before + g.planned AS total
FROM g

To'xtash shartida <= yozish. Bog'ishamolda 3-kuni jami roppa-rosa 60 ga yetadi, lekin 60 <= 60 rost va rekursiya yana bir kun yasaydi: 4-kun, 0 tup.
